design.quote: The primary endpoint of this exploratory substudy was changes in RV free wall strain (RVFWS) across the whole cohort.

population.value: Patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), LVEF of 40% or lower, NYHA Class I-III symptoms
population.quote: 190 participants with a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of 40% or lower, with New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class I-III symptoms

sample_size.quote: a total of 190 patients were enrolled, of whom 160 were included in this substudy

intervention.quote: randomized to receive either empagliflozin (at a dose of 10 mg once daily)

comparator.quote: empagliflozin (at a dose of 10 mg once daily) or placebo, on top of recommended therapy for 12 weeks

follow_up.quote: on top of recommended therapy for 12 weeks

primary_findings.quote: patients in the lowest tertile demonstrated a significant improvement with empagliflozin (treatment effect: -2.9% [95% CI: -5.0 to -0.3]; P = .027)
primary_findings.outcome: Change in RV free wall strain (RVFWS), lowest baseline tertile
